scope: Independent preparation review only; no browser, network, GPU, build, service or production-source action by reviewer. Existing excluded smoke read from disk. No performance candidate is promoted.

findings.original_problem: Accepted passed while actual app summaries emit measured; valid comparisons never reached gates. Cleanup and transition evidence were also absent from eligibility.
findings.resolution: Current summarizer accepts measured and gates on transition drain/ACK and acknowledged cleanup.

findings.original_problem: An earlier pulse RMS could identify a later input as a response without current-pulse analyser coverage. Frozen v4 CPU reproduction scored a 3030 ms stale RMS capture as a 160 ms stage response despite no current analyser sample.
findings.resolution: v5 requires audioAt inside this pulse acquisition interval and capture minus audioAt from 0 to 100 ms, plus per-pulse analyser samples.

findings.original_problem: A pulse with only 500 ms observation was scored as a failed 1000 ms response; missing offsets silently disappeared from counts.
findings.resolution: v5 predeclares pulses, ends scheduling early, labels missing/duplicate/censored events, requires acquisition tail plus complete response interval, and blocks expansion for incomplete temporal coverage.

findings.problem: Requested 60 FPS had approximately 30 Hz analyser/encode cadence. Median analyser and encode-start interval were both 33.300 ms; 248 sends over 8.3837998046875 s. At this cadence 60/40/30 requested caps may not produce distinct treatments.
findings.required_followup: Requalify the intended browser/cadence and report achieved input FPS; do not attribute an age change to a cap that did not alter admission cadence. Capture agent is replacing the excluded Chrome153 context with pinned Chrome149 and requalifying before formal timing.

checks.compiled_admission_patches: Both archived original and delivered chunk hashes match their manifest. Exactly two replacements in each legacy and Next chunk: immediately before encode and before send. Calls retain original transport.canSend with selected threshold and preserve JPEG/reliability semantics.
checks.requested_rate_scheduling: Per-job frameRate is seeded before app navigation. The unchanged app uses absolute admitted-capture deadlines, at most one capture per RAF, and records achieved input FPS. Renderer cadence is not modified by the rate setting.
checks.ordered_barrier: Reliable ordered browser channel is checked. The in-band nonce reaches server after earlier inputs; ACK waits for empty bootstrap/mailbox, all worker pending/flight/compile state idle, and outgoing buffer empty. Earlier output sends precede ACK on the same ordered channel. Post-barrier snapshots are retained before navigation/config changes.
checks.source_age_and_order: Base app harness uses observed common main/stage wall time, validates IDs/order and requested worker telemetry, and records capture-to-receive/RAF/GL ages. Input metrics retain all tail fractions and gaps; renderer events are not physical display presentation.
checks.excluded_smoke: measured with no problems, two complete pulse indices and stage responses, both admission sites exercised, final ordered ACK passed and pages-closed cleanup. Its ~30 Hz cadence remains excluded from rate-cap qualification.

n06.grid: 3 resolutions x 1/2 active workers x baseline/terminal-noop configuration bundles x 3 repeats
n06.ordering: Within each resolution, r0 and r2 forward, r1 reversed; alternating order is not a perfectly symmetric count of directions.
n06.configuration: Same requested 60 FPS, 256 KiB input threshold, mailbox enabled, 128 CPU threads and 60-second windows. Baseline CPU output cast versus terminal-noop GPU output cast is a bundle comparison, not terminal-skip-only attribution.
n06.routing: Dispatcher admits only GPU IDs below activeWorkers; warmup and measured worker-ID/clock/thread/cast checks cover the requested pool. Report one/two active GPUs on the same two-GPU host with both models loaded.
n06.qualification: Reuse corrected v5-or-later probe/harness. Input summarize.py expects comparison/role/pair fields and is not the N06 scaling aggregator.

limitations: No timed performance result or image-quality promotion is inferred from preparation checks or excluded smoke.
Impulse metadata tests sampled input and model/output delivery, not perceptual strength, semantic adherence, or physical display timing.
Raw callback/input-admission counters have their own recording boundaries; use the common frozen interval for FPS/age claims.
